title: First Come, Only Once
statementMd:
Remove duplicate numbers but **keep the order in which each first appeared**. A `LinkedHashSet` remembers insertion order and ignores repeats.

**Input**
Line 1: `n` (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000). Line 2: n integers.

**Output**
The distinct values in first-seen order, space-separated.
hints: set.add(x) does nothing if x is already there.
Loop over the set to print — its order is the order you added things.
